# Keep omitted, null and empty FCC values inside the permission guard

Current MV3 setter still uses strict null to restore defaults, empty string for nocopy://, and truthy IDs for folder overrides. Entry 523 places that behavior inside accountsRead rather than rewriting the sentinel meanings. Reuse the existing tri-state lesson and test distinctions while repairing permission checks. The read tests explicitly pass undefined and expect a reset; the conversion from the extension caller to native setter was not traced here. Native null/undefined semantics must be read at their own boundary.

Scope: mail/components/extensions/parent.
